_readme: Feed for news.html 'Tekken posts'. Daily updates edit ONLY this file. 'posts' is newest first; each item: id (X post id), name (display name), handle (no @), date (ISO 8601 UTC), text (plain post text, no HTML), url (https://x.com/<handle>/status/<id>). Keep 3-6 items. Bump 'updated'.
